purpose: Owner requested adapting fiction-writing material for Known Reach grimdark, horror and space science fiction and using it in future writing chats.
adaptation: Project-specific craft guidance and a chat prompt, written for the Known Reach and its existing rules; source inspiration attributed and full MIT license included. No upstream code or installer is run.
scope: Prospective writing guidance and new owner-directed side-story format; no story prose, established canon, main-novel scene format or comic rules revised.
side_story_rule: Owner directed a maximum of 6,000 story-prose words, no internal scene captions or headings and no continuation options for new side stories; a title is allowed.
